title: Acquisition guide for visual communications

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Keep creative effort inside the established identity so new work builds recognition instead of repeatedly replacing it.
strategic_value: Directing partners toward ideas and content can let Helsinki gain variety while retaining shared visual equity.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture states the assignment boundary, emphasizes idea/content/concept and links to an external acquisition guide.
practical_value: Brief a new creative solution within the identity rather than asking the supplier to add identity elements.

content_islands.name: Commission boundary
content_islands.spec: State that assignments stay within the visual identity and additions are not part of the quote.

content_islands.name: Creative emphasis and resource
content_islands.spec: Follow with idea/content/concept guidance and the acquisition-guide link.

reference_purposes.Application: The section directs attention to idea, content and concept within the existing identity.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Partners are not expected to add to the visual identity, and such additions should not be included in their quote.
